description: REQ-3 only requires buildSeedPlan to throw when parentBalanceUsdc < seedUsdc; neither the spec nor the implementation enforces that the parent retain any reserve after seeding. Because REQ-1 makes minBalanceUsdc operator-configurable and ANICCA_SEED_USDC (run.sh) is independently operator-configurable, an operator (or a verification run whose overrides leak into the real dotenv per FIND-006) can set ANICCA_SPAWN_MIN_BALANCE <= ANICCA_SEED_USDC, letting a parent legally spawn a child using its ENTIRE on-chain balance and immediately re-enter low_balance dormancy with $0 left for its own future operations. Neither the spec's edge-case discussion nor lib/__tests__/seed.test.js enumerates or tests a 'parent must retain a reserve after seeding' invariant.
